Both review items are fixed, pushed as `454b148f` on PR #363, and closed out.

- **Bugbot (medium, nested warning misfires)**: the warning now skips an outer repository that *is* the user's home directory — a git-tracked home is dotfiles, not a project — while deeper nesting (a clone inside a monorepo) still warns. Replied on the [bugbot thread](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/pull/363#discussion_r4353812093).
- **Trail finding (low, `init-agents` removed without a pointer)**: `init-agents` now fails with `init-agents was folded into "setup"; run "entire graph setup" (same flags)` instead of a generic unknown-command error. I kept it a removal rather than a hidden alias so the rename propagates to scripts. Finding resolved on the trail.

One detail worth knowing: the finding lived on **trail #276**, which was auto-created when I pushed the branch — not on the handoff trail #275 you linked. You now have two trails for the same work; #275 (no branch bound, phase "planning") may be worth closing or merging into #276.

content.text:
Done — PR [#365](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/pull/365) makes `entire graph setup` render like `entire brain setup`.

**What graph printed before** (one bare line per file write):
```
wrote /path/.entire/agent-guide.md
updated /path/AGENTS.md
updated /path/CLAUDE.md
wrote /path/.claude/settings.local.json (Claude Code SubagentStart hook; per-user, keep it untracked)
```

**What it prints now** (one settled row per phase, brain's visual language):
```
✓ agent instructions written (.entire/agent-guide.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md)
✓ Claude hook        wrote .claude/settings.local.json (Claude Code SubagentStart hook; per-user, keep it untracked)
```
Reruns say `already current (…)` / `unchanged …`, and `--no-claude-hook` settles a muted `− Claude hook  skipped (--no-claude-hook)` row. At a terminal the glyphs are bold-colored from the shared Entire palette; under a pipe the rows are the same bytes minus color; non-UTF-8 locales get `+`/`-` fallbacks.

One framework decision worth knowing: brain's `setupui` sits on the old charmbracelet-v1 import paths, while graph already ships the same framework under the new `charm.land` v2 paths (its `impact` progress UI uses it, with the shared `entireio/cli` palette). So I implemented brain's row model and styling conventions on graph's existing stack instead of copying `internal/tui` — a verbatim port would have vendored a second copy of the framework. The mirrored `agentsetup` files are untouched: the command now composes rows from `InstallChanged` plus a new quiet `InstallClaudeSubagentHookChanged` in graph-specific `claude_hook.go`.

Validation: three new tests (pipe output has no escapes and aligns, ASCII fallback, end-to-end one-row-per-phase incl. rerun and opt-out), existing hook assertions preserved verbatim, full `internal/cli`/`agentsetup`/`cmd` suites green, and I eyeballed both the styled TTY output and the plain piped output. One hiccup I caught and fixed along the way: my first rebase onto the fresh main silently carried zero commits (I'd committed before branching), so I cherry-picked the work onto `setup-styled-rows` and also reunited `shellQuotedRepoDir` with its doc comment, which the previous PR had orphaned.
